verdict.rationale: The GitHub docs show you can install the ZCode runtime locally and serve its web interface from your own machine or LAN with `zcode --web`, `--host 0.0.0.0`, `--port`, and token auth. Data directory and provider config paths are also configurable locally. However, the community notes it is closed source, and nothing shows the model/API backend can run on your own infrastructure; it appears tied to cloud GLM service and login credits. Missing for 10: source availability for true self-hosting, a documented self-hosted or offline model/backend option, server deployment docs (e.g. Docker or service setup), and independent hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted web deployment.
